package postgres

import (
	"fmt"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type learningPathRowStub struct{ now time.Time }

func (stub learningPathRowStub) Scan(dest ...any) error {
	if len(dest) != 14 {
		return fmt.Errorf("learning path scan destinations=%d want=14", len(dest))
	}
	values := []any{
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		"go.backend", "fingerprint-v1", domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, "course-planner-v1",
		"initial_plan", "Build a Go API", domain.LearningPathStatusActive, true, int64(2), stub.now, stub.now,
	}
	for index, value := range values {
		switch target := dest[index].(type) {
		case *string:
			*target = value.(string)
		case *domain.LearningPathStatus:
			*target = value.(domain.LearningPathStatus)
		case *bool:
			*target = value.(bool)
		case *int64:
			*target = value.(int64)
		case *time.Time:
			*target = value.(time.Time)
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("unexpected scan target %T", dest[index])
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func TestScanLearningPathIncludesLifecycleColumns(t *testing.T) {
	path, err := scanLearningPath(learningPathRowStub{now: time.Now().UTC()})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("scan learning path: %v", err)
	}
	if path.Status != domain.LearningPathStatusActive || !path.IsPrimary || path.Version != 2 ||
		path.CourseFingerprint != path.CurriculumRevision {
		t.Fatalf("lifecycle columns were not mapped: %+v", path)
	}
}
